purpose: Describe frozen detector, no variant selection and no new strategy test
historical_sample: Reuse PR50 four-year NPZ; no2019 extension; same development/evaluation split and purges
trace: Read-only sys.settrace of exact original function; no monkeypatch or rewritten signal logic; assert traced events/audit equal untraced and published episode totals
individual_turns: Simple slope sign change distinguished from frozen2-before+2-after turns
window_audit: Stateless last-three-close opportunity counts are diagnostic only; compare actual token retention/cancellation, never simulate trades from alternative opportunities
nonexclusive_failures: Also publish all failed flags together; marginal elimination depends on explicit gate order, not causal indicator importance
november: 12-15November2026 in Europe/Madrid, both Spot and USD-M, original September initialization preserved; only data closed before public server cutoff; no invented rest of15November
availability: Historical replay earliest possible close; original emission time UNKNOWN, not a prospective capture
latency_reference: All2+2 AO turns in diagnostic window, including losers, and separately highlighted owner case. Vertex i-2; same candle low/high is hindsight NONCAUSAL; first slope at vertex+1; AO2+2 at vertex+2; first matching full frozen event within next24h, no substitutions. If no full event: NOT_CONFIRMED
latency_prices: Display extreme low/high and next-open prices after each close; favorable/adverse maximum before/after stage and fixed horizon returns separately; never label hindsight return as executable profit
latency_censoring: Incomplete subsequent horizons are CENSORED; maximum after stage over common vertex+24h endpoint only if fully observed

costs.funding: same Binance USD-M settlements and uncertainty bounds in both scenarios; not Bitunix actual funding/execution
costs.cohort: Every published PR50 ALL/Q75/Q90 outcome and original matched control indices; no reselection

power.sigma: Reconstruct development Q75 paired-excess values from published outcomes/control rows; show sample SD ddof1 and required_n formula, plus exact match to frozen power artifacts
power.inference: No new winning classification, Holm family unchanged
